items.name: Glowcap
items.text: A small pale mushroom that glows blue-green in the dark. Crush one on the ground to leave a glowing arrow where you face; everyone sees it for a day.

items.name: Fir resin
items.text: Amber sap from the old firs, hard on the outside and sticky inside. It burns slow and bright: feed it to a fire.

items.name: Scrap metal
items.text: Rusted metal from cars and cabins nobody came back for. Still good for patching things, and heavy to carry.

items.name: Copper wire
items.text: Copper wire from where the old power line came down. Sometimes it still hums, and on aurora nights more of it turns up by the poles.

items.name: Cloth scraps
items.text: Strips of curtain and blanket from the rooms and cars people left behind. Still dry, so they catch fast in a fire.
items.about: Cloth mends gear at the workbench, and it catches fast in a fire.

items.name: Cedar bark
items.text: Long strips of bark off the old cedars of the Far Woods, dry and stringy inside. It burns hot and slow: feed it to a fire.
items.about: It burns in a fire, 4 minutes a strip.

items.name: Peat
items.text: A brick of peat the town cut from the Marsh and stacked to dry, and never came back for: dark, crumbling, smelling of smoke already. It burns low and long, all night: feed it to a fire.
items.about: It burns in a fire, 15 minutes a brick.

items.name: Old battery
items.text: A heavy dry cell stamped NAPO, a little charge still in it. NAPO's field kit ran on them: its radios, its lamps, the instruments at its posts. A lantern made at the workbench runs on them.
items.about: NAPO's field kit ran on them, and so does a lantern made at the workbench.

items.name: Huckleberries
items.text: Small dark-blue berries off the low bushes out in the clearings, sweet and a little sour. Pressed into cakes by a fire, they keep for a trip.

items.name: Fiddleheads
items.text: The tight green curls of young ferns, picked where the ground stays wet by the water. Good in a stew.

items.name: Fir tips
items.text: Soft new growth off the ends of the fir branches, bright green and sharp with sap. Steeped at a fire, they make a tea that warms you through.

items.name: Chanterelles
items.text: Golden mushrooms that push up through the moss while it rains, and go soon after. They smell of apricots.

items.name: Anomaly shard
items.text: A sliver of something like glass, warm even in the cold. It gives off a light of its own. The Old Stone in town wants them back.
items.about: The Old Stone in town wants shards back: enough of them wake it.

items.name: Live shard
items.text: A shard that broke loose while the woods grew restless, still humming with it. Stash it soon: it is worth much more while it glows, and everyone can see you carry it.

items.name: Thermos
items.text: Hot coffee someone left by the fire for whoever comes next. Drink it to get some energy back.
items.about: Hot coffee: drink one for 30 energy when you run low.

items.name: Road flare
items.text: A red road flare from a glovebox. Light it and nothing comes near you while it burns, and whatever clings to your back lets go.
items.about: Light one and nothing comes near you for 45 seconds, and whatever clings to your back lets go.

items.name: Hand warmer
items.text: A flat packet from NAPO's first-aid stores. Crack it and it stays hot in your glove for five minutes, and the cold bites much less.
items.about: Use one out in the cold: cold resistance +40% for 5 minutes. A second one starts the 5 minutes again; it does not add up.

items.name: Rad tablet
items.text: A white tablet from a NAPO first-aid strip, issued to the crews who worked near the glow. NAPO pressed them from glowcaps, the label says. For five minutes after one, the glow of the anomalies reaches you much less.
items.about: Take one before the glow: radiation resistance +40% for 5 minutes. A second one starts the 5 minutes again; it does not add up.

items.name: Fir-tip tea
items.text: Fir tips steeped in a flask of hot water, bright and sharp. Drunk, it warms you through: 15 more energy on your bar until you come home.

items.name: Chanterelle stew
items.text: Chanterelles and fiddleheads stewed in a tin over the fire. Eaten, it keeps the cold out: cold bites 15% less until you come home.

items.name: Berry pemmican
items.text: Huckleberries pressed into dense little cakes and dried by the fire. Eaten, it keeps you going: your bag feels 15% lighter until you come home.

items.name: Strange object
items.text: Something that was not here yesterday. It is too dark out here to tell what it is: look at it in town, in the light.
items.about: Look at it closely in town, in the light, to see what it turns out to be.

items.name: Warm pebble
items.text: A smooth black pebble that never cools. While it is in your bag, rain soaks you much slower.
items.about: While it is in your bag, rain soaks you much slower.

items.name: Hollow feather
items.text: A long grey feather, light as nothing. While it is in your bag, what you carry feels lighter.
items.about: While it is in your bag, what you carry feels lighter.

items.name: Humming bead
items.text: A glass bead that hums when something is near. While it is in your bag, what wants to cling to you in the dark thinks twice.
items.about: While it is in your bag, what wants to cling to you in the dark thinks twice.

items.name: Ember coal
items.text: A lump of coal that never went out, red deep inside and warm as a hand. While it is in your bag, fires warm you faster.
items.about: While it is in your bag, fires warm you 20% faster.

items.name: Pale moth
items.text: A moth as pale as the watchers' faces, asleep in a fold of your bag. It wakes to the light of a crushed glowcap, and a little of your strength comes back with it.
items.about: While it is in your bag, crushing a glowcap gives you 1 energy.

items.name: Resin tear
items.text: A drop of old resin gone hard and clear as amber, with a seed caught inside it. Only the old cedars of the Far Woods weep them. While it is in your bag, 85 steps or more from home you tire 10% slower.
items.about: While it is in your bag, 85 steps or more from home you tire 10% slower.

items.name: Fused glass
items.text: Sand and stone from the scar in the Burn, melted into green glass where the light came up, and cooled with bubbles in it. It is warm, and two lumps ring when they touch. A lantern at the workbench is made around two lumps of it.
items.about: Only the scar in the Burn gives it. The workbench makes a lantern with it.

items.name: Rime quartz
items.text: Clear quartz from the stones on the crest of the Ridge, furred with rime that never melts. It stays cold by a fire, and it hums a little in the hand. At the workbench it hardens the points of crampons.
items.about: Only on the crest of the Ridge. At the workbench it hardens the points of crampons.

items.name: NAPO lockbox
items.text: A grey steel box with NAPO stencilled on the lid, sealed since the evacuation. The residents keep one for whoever comes back on every day of a week. Open it at the chest.
items.seal: It has been sealed since the evacuation.

items.name: Bundle
items.text: Someone else's things, tied up to carry to the lost and found box in Stonebrook Lodge, by Walt. Leave it there, and it goes back to them.

items.name: Map of Stonebrook
items.text: Stonebrook, drawn by hand by someone who stayed: the lodge, the Old Stone, the pond and the two roads out of town. It never tells you where you are: find the lodge, the Old Stone and the street lights around you, and work it out.

items.name: Map of the Near Woods
items.text: An old paper map, drawn by hand by someone who walked the woods. It never tells you where you are: find the road, the pond, the poles and the cabins around you, and work it out.

items.name: Map of the South Road
items.text: A map of NAPO's old grounds, traced by hand from one of NAPO's own. It never tells you where you are: find the road, the station's fence, the masts and the checkpoint around you, and work it out.

items.name: Map of the Far Woods
items.text: The trapper's own map of the Far Woods, in pencil on the back of a feed-store calendar: his trails, the gorge, the loggers' camp, and the hollow he kept away from. It never tells you where you are: find the gorge, the rocks and the cabin around you, and work it out.

items.name: Map of the Burn
items.text: The trapper's map of his north line, redrawn in charcoal after the fire: the snags, the black creek, the windfall, and the scar he marked with a cross. It never tells you where you are: find the creek, the cabin and the scar around you, and work it out.

items.name: Map of the Ridge
items.text: The trappers' map of their high line, in pencil on the back of the hut's old tally: the rope, the hut, the zigzag up through the last firs, the tarn and the crest, and the icefall marked "short way, spikes". It never tells you where you are: find the hut, the tarn and the crest around you, and work it out.

items.name: Map of the Marsh
items.text: The peat cutters' map of the bog, in pencil on a page of their cutting book: the corduroy road, the hut, the two channels and the long ways round them, the cuttings, and the black pool, which they drew and did not name. It never tells you where you are: find the channels, the cuttings and the pool around you, and work it out.

items.name: Field radio
items.text: An old NAPO field radio, rewired to listen. Out in the wilds it crackles, louder the nearer you are to something strange: a shard, a strange object, or copper wire on an aurora night. Anywhere else it only hums.
items.about: Out in the wilds it crackles louder the nearer you are to something strange. Its button turns it off and on.

items.name: Bolt cutters
items.text: Long-handled bolt cutters, forged from scrap at the workbench, their jaws edged with shard. They bite through a rusted padlock like a dry twig.
items.about: They bite through the rusted padlock on the shed behind the ranger's hut.

items.name: Waders
items.text: Chest waders of cloth sealed with resin, the seams bound with copper wire, a shard sewn into the lining against the cold. In them you wade the flooded culvert by the bog.
items.about: In them you wade the flooded culvert by the bog, and come out dry south of the creek.

items.name: Lantern
items.text: A lantern of scrap and wire around two lumps of fused glass, lit by NAPO's old batteries. Deep out there, in the Burn, its green-gold light holds the dark off the ground around you: whoever walks in it with you tires half as fast. It lights the way for the others, never for you.
items.about: In the Burn, whoever stands within 3 steps of you tires half as fast. More lanterns light more ground.

items.name: Crampons
items.text: Steel spikes cut from scrap and strapped under your boots with copper wire, their points hardened with rime quartz from the crest. In them you climb the icefall on the Ridge, straight up from the high hut to the snowfield.
items.about: In them you climb the icefall on the Ridge, from the high hut straight up to the snowfield.

items.name: Worn cap
items.text: A faded red cap. It keeps the hair out of your eyes and nothing else out.

items.name: Worn shirt
items.text: A thin flannel shirt under your jacket. Fine in town.

items.name: Fingerless gloves
items.text: Knitted gloves with the fingertips cut off. Your fingers still go numb in the cold.

items.name: Worn pants
items.text: Jeans with a hole in one knee.

items.name: Worn sneakers
items.text: Sneakers that soak through in the first puddle.

items.name: Backpack
items.text: A school backpack. Eight things fit in it.

items.name: Wool cap
items.text: A thick knitted cap. Cold bites 15% less.

items.name: Raincoat
items.text: A yellow raincoat under your jacket. Rain soaks you 35% slower, and cold bites 10% less.

items.name: Rubber gloves
items.text: Thick rubber gloves from an old toolbox. They take a quarter of the sting out of electricity.

items.name: Lined pants
items.text: Canvas pants lined with blanket. Cold bites 15% less, rain soaks you 10% slower.

items.name: Rubber boots
items.text: Tall rubber boots. They keep your feet dry and take a fifth of the sting out of electricity.

items.name: Hiking pack
items.text: A hiking pack with side pockets. Twelve things fit in it.

items.name: Welding gloves
items.text: Thick leather gloves, scorched at the fingertips. A fire flash burns a third less.

items.name: Lead-lined cap
items.text: A cap with lead sewn into its lining, the way NAPO's field crews wore them. Heavy, but it takes a third of the glow out of the anomalies.

items.name: Storm coat
items.text: A long waxed coat with copper stitched through the seams. It keeps out rain, cold and a little lightning, and gives you 5 more energy.

items.name: Insulated gloves
items.text: Lineman’s gloves wrapped in copper-threaded cloth. Electricity stings a third less.

items.name: Expedition pack
items.text: A frame pack for long trips. Sixteen things fit, and it carries so well you have 5 more energy.

items.name: Expedition boots
items.text: Heavy boots with rubber soles and wool inside. Good against cold, wet and electricity alike.

items.name: Shard-lined cap
items.text: A cap lined with slivers of glass that hum against your skull. Half the glow of the anomalies never reaches you, and you have 10 more energy.
items.about: Put it on from your bag: half the glow of the anomalies never reaches you.

items.name: Crew hood
items.text: A white hood with a clear visor, from the suits NAPO's crews wore when they kept coming in after the town left. A third of the glow of the anomalies stays out, and some of the cold.
items.about: Put it on from your bag: a third of the glow of the anomalies stays out, and some of the cold.

items.name: Crew jacket
items.text: The jacket of a white NAPO suit, taped at the seams, a crew number stencilled on its back. The crews wore them when they kept coming in after the town left. It keeps out the glow, the heat of a flash and the wind, and gives you 5 more energy.
items.about: Put it on from your bag: it keeps out the glow, the heat of a flash and the wind, and gives you 5 more energy.

items.name: Crew gloves
items.text: Thick white gloves taped at the wrists, from a NAPO crew's suit. Sparks sting a third less through them, and a fire flash burns less.
items.about: Put them on from your bag: sparks sting a third less, and a fire flash burns less.

items.name: Crew trousers
items.text: The trousers of a white NAPO suit, the knees gone grey from kneeling in the woods. A quarter of the glow stays out, and some of the cold and the rain.
items.about: Put them on from your bag: a quarter of the glow stays out, and some of the cold and the rain.

items.name: Crew boots
items.text: White rubber boots from a NAPO crew's suit, their soles still caked with mud from deep in the woods. Electricity stings less through them, and some of the glow and the cold stay out.
items.about: Put them on from your bag: electricity stings less, and some of the glow and the cold stay out.

items.name: Old photograph
items.text: Stonebrook before: the sawmill running, the street full of people, and the Old Stone whole, without its crack.

items.name: Brass compass
items.text: The ranger's brass compass, worn smooth where a thumb opened it. Its needle turns toward the woods, whichever way you hold it.

items.name: Pole tag
items.text: A tin tag stamped N-16, off the last pole of the north line. W.P. is scratched into the back.

items.name: Tin whistle
items.text: Wren Barlow's whistle. The paint is worn off where small fingers held it, and it still carries.

items.name: NAPO staff badge
items.text: BARLOW, D. · FIELD CREW DRIVER. The photo on it has faded to a pale square.

items.name: Rag rug
items.text: A rug braided from strips of cloth, soft and warm underfoot.
items.spoiled: What is left of a rug: rotten through where the roof leaked.

items.name: Oil lamp
items.text: A new lamp on the table, burning resin. Its light is warm and steady.
items.spoiled: An old lamp on the table. Its glass is cracked, and its wick rotted away long ago.

items.name: Trophy shelf
items.text: A shelf for the strangest things you brought home: the charms and anomalous gear in your stash stand on it.
items.spoiled: An empty shelf, warped with damp.

items.name: Bed
items.text: A proper bed again: a thick mattress, clean sheets and a wool blanket.
items.spoiled: A bare bed frame. The mattress rotted away long ago.

items.name: Drying rack
items.text: A drying rack by the fire. Whatever the rain soaked is dry again by the time you walk out.
items.spoiled: A drying rack with its rails snapped. The damp warped it past saving.

items.name: Iron stove
items.text: A black iron stove with a kettle on it, crackling away. The cabin has not been this warm in years.
items.spoiled: A cold iron stove, rusted through where the damp got in. Nothing has burned in it for years.

quirks.name: Glowing steps
quirks.text: Out there, your steps glow where you walk for a while. Everyone can follow them.

quirks.name: Restless light
quirks.text: Street lights flicker as you pass under them. Everyone sees it.

quirks.name: Humming
quirks.text: It hums a minute before the region you are in grows restless, before anyone is told.

quirks.name: Hush
quirks.text: Your steps fall soft: the skulkers in the ferns hear you walking only from 4 steps, not 6.

quirks.name: Lodestone
quirks.text: It tugs, softly, while a shard lies within 5 steps of you. It never says which way.

quirks.name: Afterglow
quirks.text: When a flash discharges near you, you glow faintly for 30 seconds, and the watchers keep off you while you do. Everyone can see it.

daily.name: Thick fog
daily.text: Thick fog in the Near Woods. You will not see far, so keep to the paths you know.

daily.name: A NAPO cache
daily.text: The creek washed a NAPO cache out of its bank by the pond: scrap and wire. First come, first served.

daily.name: The watchers moved north
daily.text: The watchers keep to the far end of the Near Woods today. Near the road it is quieter.

daily.name: The watchers came closer
daily.text: The watchers came closer to the road overnight. Look behind you sooner than usual.

daily.name: A shelter fire went out
daily.text: One of the shelter fires went out overnight. Bring resin or cloth to light it again.

daily.name: Glowcaps everywhere
daily.text: Glowcaps came up all over the Near Woods after the night, even close to the road.

daily.name: The firs are weeping
daily.text: The old firs are weeping resin today. Plenty to keep the fires going.

daily.name: The cabin at the end was opened
daily.text: Someone forced the cupboards in the cabin at the end. There is cloth to take.

daily.name: Coffee in the shelters
daily.text: Someone left hot coffee in every shelter. Drink one, and leave the rest for whoever comes next.

daily.name: Flares in the old car
daily.text: Someone filled the glovebox of the old car by the power line with road flares.

daily.name: Shards near the road
daily.text: Shards broke loose closer in than usual. Look by the poles along the power line.

daily.name: Scrap by the old car
daily.text: The old car by the power line fell apart a little more overnight. Scrap lies all around it.

weekly.name: Copper week
weekly.text: Wire by every pole in the Near Woods, all week.

milestones.title: Edith is home
milestones.text:
The Old Stone woke, and Edith came up from the bunker, as she said she would.
A fire burns in the house next to yours again.

milestones.title: Smoke from the mill
milestones.text:
The fires out there stayed fed, and Arvid Holm came up from the bunker
to the mill he ran. Its stove is lit again.

milestones.title: Coffee at the lodge
milestones.text:
Maud, who cooked for NAPO's crews, heard how the town thanks each other.
She cooks at the lodge now.

works.name: The street lights on the south road
works.perk: The south road through town is lit at night.
works.title: The street lights are on
works.text:
The south road through town is lit at night again:
the way out, and the way home.

works.name: A roof over the notice board
works.perk: Under it the rain keeps off, and you dry off.
works.title: A roof over the notice board
works.text:
Under it the rain keeps off,
and you dry off before you go out.

works.name: The sawmill's roof
works.perk: The mill's floor stays dry: more scrap turns up in there.
works.title: The sawmill's roof is mended
works.text:
Its floor stays dry now,
and more scrap turns up in there.

works.name: the footbridge
works.where: by the pond, in the Near Woods

works.name: the street light
works.where: in the pond clearing, in the Near Woods

works.name: the west boardwalk
works.where: across the first channel, in the Marsh

works.name: the east boardwalk
works.where: across the second channel, in the Marsh
